intent.raw: ARE should only route through a module route when that route is available; ARE must not own or enforce the module workflow.
intent.objective: Evaluate optional module availability for registry-owned routes before route selection.
intent.operator_sentence: Ask one exact capability about one registered route, preserve its receipt, and gate rather than fall through when an explicit route is unavailable.

techniques.purpose: Keep registry route identity, module capability identity, and availability evidence distinct.
techniques.validation_note: Adversarial fixtures independently vary registry, lifecycle, capability, and returned route identity.

subagent_strategy.explanation: The implementation is one bounded in-process seam with coupled profile, port, router, and compiled-contract tests.

steps.name: Resolve verified registry route
stop_conditions: route is absent from the verified registry

techniques.purpose: Bind the availability answer to the exact registered route and capability.
techniques.validation_note: The identity-mismatch fixture must return repair_focus route-identity and no selected route.

steps.name: Select only among available registered routes
stop_conditions: more than one admissible route remains

gates.condition: Every candidate route already exists in the verified route registry and profile.
Availability query neither invokes nor governs the module workflow.
An unavailable explicit objective returns a gate without selecting an incidental lexical route.
Fresh compilation is byte-identical and registry, lifecycle, capability, and identity cases remain orthogonal.

boundaries.contract: Only a typed availability judgment and digest-bound receipt cross the boundary; workflow policy and execution remain with the module owner.

authority.execution: module workflow owner; outside this dispatch
authority.validation: router, module-port, and compiled Alch tests

promotion_splits.rule: Passing route-availability tests grants no activation, workflow authority, publication, or enforcement.

promotion_guardrails: Do not let a module invent a route absent from the registry.
Do not treat availability as activation, authorization, or workflow execution.
Do not make Define, ontology, or Alch packages global prerequisites for unbound routes.
Do not add discovery or fallback provider priority.
